skill_name: Compare a decision tree to other types of machine learning algorithms
workflow: Decision trees are a type of supervised machine learning algorithm that is used for classification tasks. Unlike other machine learning algorithms, decision trees have the added advantage of being able to visualize the decisions made by the model. This makes them easy to interpret and explain, which can be valuable for making predictions in business and other contexts.
